(I) Some apples are oranges.

(II) All grapes are oranges.

Conclusions:

(I) Some apples are oranges. - True ( All oranges are Apple means some orange is apple and some apple is orange.Hence, it is true.

(II) All grapes are oranges. - False ( All oranges is Apple and All apple is Grapes.All Grapes are oranges is possible but not definte. Hence, it is false.)

Only conclusion (I) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question: 112 people are standing in a row facing north. Mr. Into is 11th from the left end while Mr. Toni is 19th from the right end. How many people are there between Mr. Into and Mr. Toni?
questions.solution:
To find Mr. Toni's position from the left, subtract his position from the right and his own person from the total number of people.

Toni′s position from the left = Total people − Toni′s position from the right + 1.

Toni′s position from the left = 112 – 19 + 1 

=94.

questions.question: Pritam is ranked 5th from the top and 21st from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Position of Pritam from the top = 5th

Position of Pritam from the bottom = 21th

So,

Total number of students = Position of Paras from the top + Position of Paras from the bottom - 1

= 5 + 21 - 1

= 26 - 1 = 25.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
